# YM55: 后湖 Hou Hu, "Back Lake"

Wave 2 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM55` · Page: `/scenes/#YM55` · Row: `research/buildings/YM55-hou-hu/`

## What it was

后湖 Hou Hu, the Back Lake, the core water of Yuanming Yuan, ringed by the nine islands: 九洲清晏 on the south (E1153, S02), and round it 镂月开云, 天然图画, 碧桐书院, 慈云普护, 上下天光, 杏花春馆, 坦坦荡荡 and 茹古涵今, in the order S05 describes them (S05 j80:26a-j81:5a). The lake survives with its shape and has been re-dug and lined (S146, S148).

From the inventory row: **destroyed** n/a (water) (S05, S02, S01).
